Senior code review completed and written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-152440-feature-new-text-range-styling/review.json`.

### Verdict: `needs_changes`

### Findings
- **[Blocker]** `packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.test.tsx:3585` — Unit U17 was not applied (`sha_before === sha_after`), leaving the required `describe("per-range text styling", ...)` WYSIWYG integration tests (`FR-4`, `FR-5`, `FR-9`, `FR-12`, `AC-1`, `AC-3`, `AC-7`) missing. Fix by importing `actionChangeStrokeColor`, `actionChangeBackgroundColor`, and `actionChangeHighlightColor` after line 51 and anchoring the insertion on the unique final test starting at line 3585 (`it("removes a plain text in a single undo", ...)`).

### Passing Checks
- **Correctness & Snapshot Hygiene (U01–U14):** `textRanges` algebra, omission/deletion of empty `textRanges`, Canvas/SVG per-run rendering with `applyDarkModeFilter`, live static-canvas rendering while `editingTextElement` has `textRanges`, WYSIWYG selection/style sync, `ElementsDelta`, `restore`, and `reconcile` match `change_plan.md`.
- **Type Safety & Lint:** `yarn test:typecheck` and `yarn test:code` pass with 0 errors.
- **Test Coverage (U15–U16, U18–U21) & Docs (U22):** Unit, restore, reconcile, export, and collaboration tests pass without snapshot drift; changelog updated.
